description: Do several phone actions in one call, when you already know them (fill in a form: tap a field, type, tap the next one…). Each step is {"action": tap | long_press | type | scroll | press | open_app | wait, and its arguments as in that tool}; a step can name its target by "text" (its visible text or description) instead of an element id, which is surer once the screen has changed. Optional "until" on a step waits for something after it (as in wait_for). The same approvals apply to every step. The batch stops at the first step that fails or is blocked, when an approval card comes up, or when another app comes to the front. Returns what each step did; call read_screen after.

element.description: Element id from the last read_screen

target.description: type: the field's visible text or hint, instead of element

text.description: tap/long_press: the target's visible text; type: the text to type

until.description: Wait after the step for: text to appear, gone text to go, app to be in front, or settled (the screen stops changing); up to timeout_ms.

app.description: App name or package that should be in front

name: do_steps
